dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よし、噂の帰国子女とやらを見に行こう」
dialogues.en: "Alright! Let's go see the prodigal daughter!"
dialogues.text: "Alright! Let's go see the prodigal daughter!"

dialogues.jp:
１時限目の講師が教室を去ったのと同時に、杉
並が寄ってきた。
dialogues.en:
As soon as the teacher went out of the class for a minute,
Suginami had an outburst.
dialogues.text:
As soon as the teacher went out of the class for a minute,
Suginami had an outburst.

dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp:
なんだか寄ってきたパート２も、俺の鏡のよう
にとぼけた表情を浮かべている。
dialogues.en:
Nemu's and our faces showed the exact same expression, as if
staring at a mirror.
dialogues.text:
Nemu's and our faces showed the exact same expression, as if
staring at a mirror.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「は――って、なに驚いてるんだ朝倉兄妹？」
dialogues.en: "Heeeh, what are you so surprised about, Asakura siblings?"
dialogues.text: "Heeeh, what are you so surprised about, Asakura siblings?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いえ……杉並くんが、そういうミーハーなイ
　ベントに興味を持っているなんて、知らなかっ
　たから」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing much... I didn't know you were so interested in
passing fads like this."
dialogues.text:
"Nothing much... I didn't know you were so interested in
passing fads like this."

dialogues.jp: 音夢が取り｛つくろ／繕｝うように微笑む。
dialogues.en: Nemu immediately gave a face-saving smile.
dialogues.text: Nemu immediately gave a face-saving smile.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「なんだミーハーってのは？　売れない芸人コ
　ンビか？」
dialogues.en:
"A fad-follower? I prefer to think of myself as an unbuyable
actor combination!"
dialogues.text:
"A fad-follower? I prefer to think of myself as an unbuyable
actor combination!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「素ボケにはつっこんでやらんが、珍しいを通
　り越してるな」
dialogues.en:
"There's definitely elements of both boke and tsukkomi in
you."
dialogues.text:
"There's definitely elements of both boke and tsukkomi in
you."

dialogues.jp:
転入生が可愛い女の子と聞いて男子が動き出す
のは目に見えていたが、こいつだけは意外だ。
dialogues.en:
I could see in his eyes that the real reason he wanted to
see the new transfer student; he had heard that it was a
cute girl.
dialogues.text:
I could see in his eyes that the real reason he wanted to
see the new transfer student; he had heard that it was a
cute girl.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いやいやぁ……卒業間近に転入してくるなん
　て、なにか陰謀の匂いがするだろうが。それ
　に帰国子女というのはラスボスっぽい」
dialogues.en:
"But really... a transfer student this close to graduation
has the smell of a conspiracy. And she keeps mentioning a
Last Boss..."
dialogues.text:
"But really... a transfer student this close to graduation
has the smell of a conspiracy. And she keeps mentioning a
Last Boss..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「つまり｛・・／未知｝だ！！」
dialogues.en: "In short... a mystery!!"
dialogues.text: "In short... a mystery!!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "...Haah."
dialogues.text: "...Haah."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、お前はまず自分を研究し尽くしたほう
　がいいと思うが……陰謀ってなにするんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"You can go research these things by yourself... what kind
of conspiracies anyway?"
dialogues.text:
"You can go research these things by yourself... what kind
of conspiracies anyway?"

dialogues.jp:
どうやったら、こんな学園で陰謀を張り巡らせ
られるのだろうか。
dialogues.en:
This school seems susceptible to conspiracies for some
reason.
dialogues.text:
This school seems susceptible to conspiracies for some
reason.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「あ？　テストで俺をＴＯＰの座から落とした
　り、購買のパンを独り占めしたり、実は誰か
　のメイドさんだったり」
dialogues.en:
"To unseat me from the top of the honour roll, to monopolize
the bread market in the cafeteria, that she's someone's
maid."
dialogues.text:
"To unseat me from the top of the honour roll, to monopolize
the bread market in the cafeteria, that she's someone's
maid."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……最後のだけは切実だな。特に料理」
dialogues.en: "...Please be serious. Especially about food."
dialogues.text: "...Please be serious. Especially about food."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん……なにか含みがある発言が耳に届き
　ましたけど？」
dialogues.en:
"Nii-san... what was that different tone in your speech that
I heard?"
dialogues.text:
"Nii-san... what was that different tone in your speech that
I heard?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、別に」
dialogues.en: "No, nothing."
dialogues.text: "No, nothing."

dialogues.jp:
ただ単に、ウチの食生活が絶望的だなんて一言
も含んでいないはずだ……悟られてはいけない。
dialogues.en:
Just a little reference about his eating habits... nothing
she would understand.
dialogues.text:
Just a little reference about his eating habits... nothing
she would understand.

dialogues.jp: 「で、お前はどうしたんだ音夢？」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, what're you going to do, Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, what're you going to do, Nemu?"

dialogues.jp: 杉並を無視したくて、投げやり的に話をふる。
dialogues.en:
Deciding to ignore Suginami, I switch the focus of the
conversation.
dialogues.text:
Deciding to ignore Suginami, I switch the focus of the
conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、いえ……なんだか先ほどから嫌な雰囲気
　を感じるというのか……」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, I don't think I will... I have a bad feeling about
this..."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, I don't think I will... I have a bad feeling about
this..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「電波の受信が良くないんじゃないか。それな
　ら屋上に行ったほうがいいぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Maybe your reception just isn't good. Go up to the rooftop
and adjust it."
dialogues.text:
"Maybe your reception just isn't good. Go up to the rooftop
and adjust it."

dialogues.jp: 頭上の触角を指差してやる。
dialogues.en: I point at the antennas on the top of her head.
dialogues.text: I point at the antennas on the top of her head.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「これはテレビのアンテナじゃありません！」
dialogues.en: "These aren't TV antennas!"
dialogues.text: "These aren't TV antennas!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「寝癖――ぐっ！？」
dialogues.en: "Bad case of bedh....guuh!?"
dialogues.text: "Bad case of bedh....guuh!?"

dialogues.jp: 鼻っ柱を押さえて杉並がうずくまる。
dialogues.en:
Suginami quickly crouched down, his nose pressed
considerably into his face.
dialogues.text:
Suginami quickly crouched down, his nose pressed
considerably into his face.

dialogues.jp:
｛あまか／天翔｝けちゃいそうな音夢の神速の裏拳が決まっ
たか……。
dialogues.en: That's the power of Nemu's God-Speed Backhand...
dialogues.text: That's the power of Nemu's God-Speed Backhand...

dialogues.jp:
「馬鹿だな……女性の髪は命よりも大切だと言
　うのに」
dialogues.en:
"Idiot... if you insult a girl's hair, you might as well be
prepared to pay for it with your life."
dialogues.text:
"Idiot... if you insult a girl's hair, you might as well be
prepared to pay for it with your life."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さんがそれを言いますか」
dialogues.en: "As he says."
dialogues.text: "As he says."

dialogues.jp:
頭の触角をなでながら音夢がデス小声で｛にら／睨｝んで
くる。
dialogues.en:
Nemu, who definitely did not have antennas on her head, said
in a soft, yet chilling voice.
dialogues.text:
Nemu, who definitely did not have antennas on her head, said
in a soft, yet chilling voice.

dialogues.jp: と、杉並が机に手をついて立ち上がる。
dialogues.en: Suginami slowly stood up again, using his desk as support.
dialogues.text: Suginami slowly stood up again, using his desk as support.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうなさったの杉並くん？」
dialogues.en: "How was that, Suginami-kun?"
dialogues.text: "How was that, Suginami-kun?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「くっ……やはりお前の周囲には時空の断層が
　展開しているのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Ugh... so you distorted the space-time continuum around
you?"
dialogues.text:
"Ugh... so you distorted the space-time continuum around
you?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「んなわけないだろうが、それは、そこにいる
　悪魔が――ん？」
dialogues.en: "That's more like some power a demon wo...eh?"
dialogues.text: "That's more like some power a demon wo...eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なに？」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「猫か？」
dialogues.en: "A cat?"
dialogues.text: "A cat?"

dialogues.jp: なんだか廊下の外がガヤガヤと騒がしい。
dialogues.en: There was a bustle of activity at the corridor outside.
dialogues.text: There was a bustle of activity at the corridor outside.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだろうな？」
dialogues.en: "What's happening?"
dialogues.text: "What's happening?"

dialogues.jp:
三者同様、疑問符を浮かべた表情で廊下を覗き
にいく。
dialogues.en:
The three of us, with identical quizzical expressions,
peeked out at the corridor.
dialogues.text:
The three of us, with identical quizzical expressions,
peeked out at the corridor.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……なんだろう、あの人だかり？」
dialogues.en: "...What are those people doing?"
dialogues.text: "...What are those people doing?"

dialogues.jp:
音夢の指差した先には、主に女子を中心とした
嵐が生じている。
dialogues.en: Nemu pointed to the girl right in the center of the storm.
dialogues.text: Nemu pointed to the girl right in the center of the storm.

dialogues.speaker: Female Student
dialogues.jp:
「やだ、可愛いすぎるよ〜♪　お嬢ちゃん、こ
　のお菓子食べる？」
dialogues.en: "Yaaa, sooo cute!~ Miss, do you want to eat this sweet?"
dialogues.text: "Yaaa, sooo cute!~ Miss, do you want to eat this sweet?"

dialogues.speaker: Female Student
dialogues.jp: 「こっち向いて〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Come over here~♪"
dialogues.text: "Come over here~♪"

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Voice
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ、わわ！？　ひっぱるな〜〜〜！」
dialogues.en: "Unya, whawha? Don't pull me~~~"
dialogues.text: "Unya, whawha? Don't pull me~~~"

dialogues.jp:
渦の中心に女の子がいるみたいだが、背が低す
ぎるので突き上げられた手が、かろうじて見え
るだけだ。
dialogues.en:
At the center of the swirl of activity, a short girl was
being pushed into the air, allowing us a better view of her.
dialogues.text:
At the center of the swirl of activity, a short girl was
being pushed into the air, allowing us a better view of her.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「あれが噂の転入生かな？」
dialogues.en: "Would that be the rumoured transfer student?"
dialogues.text: "Would that be the rumoured transfer student?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「だろうけど……凄い人気だな」
dialogues.en: "I guess so... she's extremely popular already."
dialogues.text: "I guess so... she's extremely popular already."

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Voice
dialogues.en: "Stop it~! ....Mooove~~~~~!"
dialogues.text: "Stop it~! ....Mooove~~~~~!"

dialogues.speaker: Mysterious Voice
dialogues.jp:
「ん？　どっかで聞いたことがあるような声だ
　な」
dialogues.en: "Hm? That voice sounds so familiar."
dialogues.text: "Hm? That voice sounds so familiar."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あれ、兄さんも？」
dialogues.en: "Eh, you too, brother?"
dialogues.text: "Eh, you too, brother?"

dialogues.jp:
眉をよせて、音夢も小首をかしげて考え込んで
いる。
dialogues.en:
Raising her eyebrows, Nemu slanted her head to the side, in
thought.
dialogues.text:
Raising her eyebrows, Nemu slanted her head to the side, in
thought.

dialogues.jp:
「なんだろう……この、聞くと反射的に逃げた
　くなる声は……」
dialogues.en:
"Man... I can't seem to remember EXACTLY where this voice
comes from, yet it's so familiar..."
dialogues.text:
"Man... I can't seem to remember EXACTLY where this voice
comes from, yet it's so familiar..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんだろうねぇ、これ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I know..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I know..."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おぃ、ふたり共、ぼさっとしてると巻き込ま
　れるぞ」
dialogues.en: "Oy, you two, if you stay there, you'd get sucked in too."
dialogues.text: "Oy, you two, if you stay there, you'd get sucked in too."

dialogues.jp:
杉並の声に教室に避難しようとした時、ふと、
人垣の中に懐かしい小動物を見た気がした。
dialogues.en:
At the same time Suginami's voice emnated from the refuge of
the classroom, a tiny, familiar face emerged from the crowd.
dialogues.text:
At the same time Suginami's voice emnated from the refuge of
the classroom, a tiny, familiar face emerged from the crowd.

dialogues.jp: 「あ？　え？　さくらんぼッ！？」
dialogues.en: "Ah? Eh? Sakuranbo!?"
dialogues.text: "Ah? Eh? Sakuranbo!?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「お兄ちゃん！？」
dialogues.en: "Onii-chan!?"
dialogues.text: "Onii-chan!?"

dialogues.jp:
波をかきわけて、ひょっこりと見知った顔が飛
び出してきた。
dialogues.en:
Squeezing her way through the crowd, the familiar face
suddenly hit me like a ton of bricks.
dialogues.text:
Squeezing her way through the crowd, the familiar face
suddenly hit me like a ton of bricks.

dialogues.en: "Wha!?"
dialogues.text: "Wha!?"

dialogues.jp:
あまりにも見知りすぎて立ちくらみがする。ま
るまんま記憶通りの、６年前のさくらんぼがそ
こにいた。
dialogues.en:
Now I could see the entire body of the girl now. No doubt
about it, it's the Sakura from 6 years ago.
dialogues.text:
Now I could see the entire body of the girl now. No doubt
about it, it's the Sakura from 6 years ago.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり、お兄ちゃんだ〜♪」
dialogues.en: "It really is you, onii-chan~♪"
dialogues.text: "It really is you, onii-chan~♪"

dialogues.jp:
ばっ、と風を切る音でも立てそうな勢いで、さ
くらんぼが飛び込んでくる。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, she flew at me like a torpedo.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, she flew at me like a torpedo.

dialogues.jp: ビシッ――！
dialogues.en: *pish*
dialogues.text: *pish*

dialogues.jp:
さくらを押しとどめるように、その額に音夢の
｛しょうてい／掌底｝が決まっていた。
dialogues.en:
Stopping Sakura's seemingly unchangable course was the palm
of Nemu.
dialogues.text:
Stopping Sakura's seemingly unchangable course was the palm
of Nemu.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「見事なカウンターだ」
dialogues.en: "An excellent counter."
dialogues.text: "An excellent counter."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おほほほほほほほほほ……はぁ」
dialogues.en: "Oh ho ho ho ho ho ho ho....haah."
dialogues.text: "Oh ho ho ho ho ho ho ho....haah."

dialogues.jp:
わけの分からない笑い声をあげて、音夢がため
息をつく。
dialogues.en: Nemu laughed indecipherably, then let out a small sigh.
dialogues.text: Nemu laughed indecipherably, then let out a small sigh.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「痛いよ音夢ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "That hurt, Nemu-chan."
dialogues.text: "That hurt, Nemu-chan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ！？　ごめんごめん、なんだか身体が勝
　手に――」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh?! Sorry, sorry, my hand just sort of moved on it's
own..."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh?! Sorry, sorry, my hand just sort of moved on it's
own..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、まて」
dialogues.en: "Wait a minute."
dialogues.text: "Wait a minute."

dialogues.jp: 音夢をおしのけて前に出る。
dialogues.en: I push Nemu aside and step forward.
dialogues.text: I push Nemu aside and step forward.

dialogues.jp:
「お前本当にさくらんぼなのか！？　妹とかじゃ
　――」
dialogues.en:
"Are you really Sakuranbo!? You look more like a sister
of--"
dialogues.text:
"Are you really Sakuranbo!? You look more like a sister
of--"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、懐かしいねぇ、その呼び方」
dialogues.en: "Ahhh, I've missed being called that~"
dialogues.text: "Ahhh, I've missed being called that~"

dialogues.jp: あ、本気で｛めまい／眩暈｝がしてきた。
dialogues.en: I start getting dizzy.
dialogues.text: I start getting dizzy.

dialogues.jp: 紛れもなく、
dialogues.en: For some reason,
dialogues.text: For some reason,

dialogues.jp: ありえないことに、
dialogues.en: Since I haven't seen her,
dialogues.text: Since I haven't seen her,

dialogues.jp:
さくらんぼの大きさは、別れた６年前のままだっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Sakuranbo should have grown up, but in 6 years that doesn't
look like it's happened.
dialogues.text:
Sakuranbo should have grown up, but in 6 years that doesn't
look like it's happened.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えへへ……お兄ちゃん、デコ痛いからなでて」
dialogues.en: "Eheheh... having a bit of a headache, onii-chan?"
dialogues.text: "Eheheh... having a bit of a headache, onii-chan?"

dialogues.jp:
前髪をかき上げて、白いおでこを突き出してく
る。
dialogues.en: I sweep my forelocks away, letting my forehead protrude.
dialogues.text: I sweep my forelocks away, letting my forehead protrude.

dialogues.jp:
周囲を見渡すと、意外な――意外なほど面白い
展開に皆が俺の一挙一動に注目している。
dialogues.en:
I look around for some other weird things that may be
causing this abnormality.
dialogues.text:
I look around for some other weird things that may be
causing this abnormality.

dialogues.jp: デコピンでもしたら受けるだろうか？
dialogues.en: What the hell is happening here?
dialogues.text: What the hell is happening here?

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「この未知の生物は知り合いか朝倉兄妹？」
dialogues.en: "You know this unknown life form, Asakura siblings?"
dialogues.text: "You know this unknown life form, Asakura siblings?"

dialogues.jp: ひとりだけマイペースだった。
dialogues.en: I'm the only one on my wavelength, apparently.
dialogues.text: I'm the only one on my wavelength, apparently.

dialogues.jp: 「……俺はロリコンじゃないぞ杉並」
dialogues.en: "...I'm no lolicon, Suginami."
dialogues.text: "...I'm no lolicon, Suginami."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん現実逃避しないで。間違いなく、さく
　らちゃんだよ〜」
dialogues.en:
"The truth is right in front of us, nii-san. This has to be
Sakura-chan."
dialogues.text:
"The truth is right in front of us, nii-san. This has to be
Sakura-chan."

dialogues.jp:
音夢も混乱しているのだろうが、おかしな表情
のまま俺の上着の｛すそ／裾｝をひっぱる。
dialogues.en:
In the middle of all the chaos, Nemu tugged my arm with a
weird expression on her face.
dialogues.text:
In the middle of all the chaos, Nemu tugged my arm with a
weird expression on her face.

dialogues.jp: そうか……芳乃さくらだ。
dialogues.en: That's right... Yoshino Sakura.
dialogues.text: That's right... Yoshino Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、待て音夢！　いくらなんだって同い年
　には見えないぞ、コレは！」
dialogues.en:
"No, wait Nemu! Just look at her, this thing can't be the
same age as us!"
dialogues.text:
"No, wait Nemu! Just look at her, this thing can't be the
same age as us!"

dialogues.jp:
『コレ』と差し出した指が、頭上の虚空を指し
て所在をなくす。
dialogues.en:
Pointing to "this thing", I ended up pointing at the empty
space above her head instead.
dialogues.text:
Pointing to "this thing", I ended up pointing at the empty
space above her head instead.

dialogues.jp:
体裁を整える意味を含めて、その手をポン、と
少女の頭の上におく。
dialogues.en:
I quickly lower my finger to point more properly at her
head.
dialogues.text:
I quickly lower my finger to point more properly at her
head.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「人の身体的な特徴でけなすの嫌い……でもお
　兄ちゃんは好き♪」
dialogues.en:
"I don't like people insulting my height... but I like
onii-chan♪"
dialogues.text:
"I don't like people insulting my height... but I like
onii-chan♪"

dialogues.jp:
ぎゅう〜、と腰というか、ももに少女がはりつ
く。
dialogues.en: The girl clinged onto my hips with a cute noise.
dialogues.text: The girl clinged onto my hips with a cute noise.

dialogues.speaker: Female Student
dialogues.en: "Kyaaaa!"
dialogues.text: "Kyaaaa!"

dialogues.speaker: Female Student
dialogues.jp: 「あたしもギュッ、てされたい♪」
dialogues.en: "Do that to me too, please~"
dialogues.text: "Do that to me too, please~"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「でも“ロ”だぞ」
dialogues.en: "Still not a lolicon?"
dialogues.text: "Still not a lolicon?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「静まれそこ！」
dialogues.en: "Shut up!"
dialogues.text: "Shut up!"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「あ……独占欲の炎がバーニングだ」
dialogues.en: "Ah ha... the fires of monopolization are burning."
dialogues.text: "Ah ha... the fires of monopolization are burning."

dialogues.jp: 声なき声で叫びをあげる。
dialogues.en: Another voice started talking.
dialogues.text: Another voice started talking.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ねぇ、お兄ちゃん。まだ信じてくれないの？
　せっかく帰ってきたのに“おかえり”は？」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, onii-chan. You still don't believe me? You haven't
told me "Welcome Back" yet?"
dialogues.text:
"Hey, onii-chan. You still don't believe me? You haven't
told me "Welcome Back" yet?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「はぁはぁ……君もふざけるのはよせ。さくら
　の妹か親戚だろう？」
dialogues.en:
"Don't... mess around with me. You're Sakura's sister or
relative of some sort, right?"
dialogues.text:
"Don't... mess around with me. You're Sakura's sister or
relative of some sort, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクはボクだよ〜」
dialogues.en: "I'm me~"
dialogues.text: "I'm me~"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「証拠でもあるのか？」
dialogues.en: "What evidence do you have?"
dialogues.text: "What evidence do you have?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「ん〜っと……今は何も持ってないけど……。
　あ、ふたりだけの秘密でね、昔お兄ちゃんが
　女の子のスカートを――」
dialogues.en:
"Hmmm~... what can I use to show... ah, I know, one of our
secrets! Way back, you used to like playing with girls
skirts by..."
dialogues.text:
"Hmmm~... what can I use to show... ah, I know, one of our
secrets! Way back, you used to like playing with girls
skirts by..."

dialogues.jp: ピシッ――！
dialogues.en: *pishu*
dialogues.text: *pishu*

dialogues.jp:
誘拐犯な気分で、間違いなく、さくらでしか有
り得ない少女の口をふさぐ。
dialogues.en:
There's really no mistake. This is Sakura's mouth which I
just shut closed with my hand like a kidnapper.
dialogues.text:
There's really no mistake. This is Sakura's mouth which I
just shut closed with my hand like a kidnapper.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……あ……ボク、勉強しなきゃ」
dialogues.en: "...Ah...I am... going to study now."
dialogues.text: "...Ah...I am... going to study now."

dialogues.jp:
カクカクと教室に戻ろうとしたところで、ドア
から眞子が顔を覗かせる。
dialogues.en:
Just as I was about to re-enter the classroom, Mako's face
peeped out from inside.
dialogues.text:
Just as I was about to re-enter the classroom, Mako's face
peeped out from inside.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「一体なんの騒ぎなの朝倉？」
dialogues.en: "Just what is all this fuss about, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Just what is all this fuss about, Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Wah!"
dialogues.text: "Wah!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "A proposal?"
dialogues.text: "A proposal?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……若気の至りなんだよ〜！」
dialogues.en: "...Just a show of youthful vitality~!"
dialogues.text: "...Just a show of youthful vitality~!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「知るか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, of course."
dialogues.text: "Oh, of course."

dialogues.jp: ピシャ、と戸が閉められた。
dialogues.en: I quickly shut the door from inside.
dialogues.text: I quickly shut the door from inside.

dialogues.jp: ◆転校生との再会◆
dialogues.en: ◆Reunion with the Exchange Student◆
dialogues.text: ◆Reunion with the Exchange Student◆

dialogues.jp:
休み時間、噂の転校生に出会う――それは、か
つてわかれた幼なじみの芳乃さくらだった。
dialogues.en:
During the break period, we met the rumoured transfer
student-- she happened to be an old childhood friend,
Yoshino Sakura.
dialogues.text:
During the break period, we met the rumoured transfer
student-- she happened to be an old childhood friend,
Yoshino Sakura.

dialogues.jp:
６年前と変わらぬ容姿と騒がしい性格に、これ
から先の学園生活に頭がきりきりと痛んだ……。
dialogues.en:
In 6 years, her appearance hasn't changed one bit. This is
going to add even more to my school headaches...
dialogues.text:
In 6 years, her appearance hasn't changed one bit. This is
going to add even more to my school headaches...
